title.narrative: Institutional Strengthening thru Support to National Procurement Center in Bishkek IDF Grant

description.narrative: IDF Grant for $346,000 approved on April 28, 2003, TF052468 During the IDF grant implementation period, the main objective of the Center will be to fulfill the immense training needs in procurement of public officials at all levels of government in the country, in line with the recommendations of the CPAR. In addition to the training of public officials in procurement, the National Training Center will also provide capacity building both to the central government in getting ready for a PRSC and to local communities in administering funds. The IDF funds would be used for providing technical assistance to the Center. This technical assistance would mainly comprise short-term expatriate consultants for helping the Center staff in elaboration of a business plan for the Center; for upgrading the skills of the staff of the Center in operations and management; accounting and finance; design and delivery of training programs for training-the-trainer, for public officials at all levels of government throughout the country; and for capacity building in support of the PRSC, The IDF would also finance the training of a select number of the Center staff, including the Director, abroad in a suitable international training institution.
